limits: Fixed historical sample identities and saved node counts only; no new sample selection or graph download
Model resource counters are not image likes and are not necessarily counters for the saved workflow file version
Current counters cannot establish original-collection likes, ranking, high-likes threshold, or sampling sort order
Missing, blocked, invalid, or unavailable values remain null/unknown; no retries, redirects, authentication, or fallback enumeration
No workflow graph or asset was fetched; current workflow node count was not measured
Public full file hashes, when eligible, remain current metadata hints, not remeasured hashes of the unavailable historical original bytes
